gate: C9 projectable HMT U(1) Stueckelberg/FP gauge-sector audit
question: Does the source-locked HMT local-U(1) transformation delta_alpha nu = alpha permit a pre-registered nu=0 gauge whose U(1) Faddeev-Popov kernel is field-independent, thereby removing the local-U(1) ghost-interaction ambiguity while leaving the A-constraint/reduced-measure and FDiff one-loop problems open?

source_lock.primary: P. Horava and C. M. Melby-Thompson, Phys. Rev. D 82, 064027 (2010), arXiv:1007.2410

preregistered_gauge.boundary_caveat: Any global/boundary zero-mode issue must be stated separately; no claim beyond local gauge-sector FP structure.

decision_rule: PASS_SCOPED only if the symbolic variation of chi_U1=nu under the source-locked local U(1) gives delta chi_U1=alpha, hence a field-independent identity FP kernel. This reduces one component of the quantum-evaluability blocker but does not define the complete HMT one-loop determinant.
nonclaims: No claim that the complete HMT U(1) theory is one-loop renormalizable.
No claim that the A constraint or its determinant/measure is solved.
No automatic transfer of ordinary-projectable Hořava beta functions.
No closure of full C9 radiative naturalness.
No soft-s retest or k=0.03 production is enabled.
